name: FACE_WIDTH
note: triangular reflector core face width

name: PATCH_OFFSET
note: P / P2 holes: patch connector axis -> copper face. Measured panel: axis in line with the housing back, so the panel stands this far off the face (plug nut clearance)

name: PATCH_END_INSET
note: P2 hole: same offset, this far in from the face's counter-clockwise end (top view), i.e. 25 mm off the face centre. Moved in from 14 on 2026-11-10 (user) so one coax length reaches from back-panel positions A and C (notch assumed centred on the board's long edge)

name: FACE_THICK
note: core face board (copper clad) thickness: the M4 nuts sit against its inner side

name: NUT_AF
note: M4 nut (or M4 hex standoff) across flats (3.2 mm thick). One per core corner, two flats flush against the faces: soldered to the faces, or trapped in a glued 3D-printed holder (2026-11-01; PCB service bolts 2026-11-23)

name: NUT_GAP
note: room per face between the core-corner M4 nut's flats and the face (seam fillet, tape, angle error). 0.0 until 2026-11-23 (flats flush): 0.5 so a nut drops in; moves r_M4 59.1 -> 58.1, both builds

name: NUT_PAD
note: bottom mask opening round each M4 hole for the nut solder (nut across corners ~8.1 mm)

name: HOLE_M4
note: M4 bolt, slightly loose so it finds the nut. Core-corner bolts: acrylic plate option (hand build); deck and end plate service bolts (PCB, 2026-11-23)

name: EDGE_CLEAR
note: copper pull-back from the board edge

name: RIM_MASK_WIDTH
note: exposed copper ring at the rim (copper-tape edge seal)

name: SEAM_STRIP
note: exposed strip on the bottom for soldering the core seams

name: PAD_EXPOSE
note: exposed copper round each RP-SMA hole (nut contact)

name: HOLE_RPSMA
note: RP-SMA bulkhead (thread OD 6.3 mm)

name: FACE_H
note: back panel height: square 120 x 120 faces so the core fits the enclosure

name: DIPOLE_HOLE
note: RP-SMA bulkhead at the face centre, both builds (dipole / printed fin feed). Dropped 2026-11-23 08:55, restored the same day (owner)

name: XIAO_L
note: Seeed XIAO nRF54L15 board length

name: XIAO_W
note: XIAO board width

name: XIAO_IPEX
note: IPEX4 (MHF4) centre from the XIAO centre: along toward its end, across toward the D0-D6 pin edge

name: ADAPTER_HOLE
note: 7/8 in drill for the 1/2 in male pipe adapter thread (21.3 mm OD)

name: ENC_OD
note: PP pail (housing, https://a.co/d/08ZUdBcy) outside diameter, vendor approx. 7 in

name: ENC_OH
note: PP pail outside height, vendor approx. 7.4 in

name: ENC_ID
note: PP pail inside diameter, vendor approx. 6.7 in

name: ENC_IH
note: PP pail inside height, vendor approx. 7.1 in

name: ENC_MOUTH_ID
note: PP pail opening inside diameter, vendor approx. 6.3 in: the deck and module plate pass through it

name: RF_FREQ
note: BLE band centre (2402-2480 MHz): sets the wavelength on the formulas page (page 8)

name: RF_SECTORS
note: rf_model: sectors (core faces) the RF model builds; 3 today. sector_model.py --sectors / size_sweep.py --sectors override it

name: RF_FEED_DEPTH
note: rf_model: default dipole feed point depth below the deck (sector_model.py --centre)

name: DUCK_FEED_DEPTH
note: rf_model: HiRO H50327 duck (108 mm long, base on the deck jack) modelled as a half-wave dipole fed this far below the deck; 55 and 75 give 19-22 deg bearing error, a small effect (README)

name: CHIP_STANDIN_LENGTH
note: rf_model size_sweep.py: short centre-fed dipole standing in for a chip antenna (pattern only; the chip's match and carrier ground are not modelled)

name: COLLAR_HOLE
note: three M3 holes (plated, GND ring) that register the deck to the collar; positions M3_POS

name: XIAO_PAD
note: castellation pad for hand soldering: length (out from the board edge 1.7 mm) x width

name: CORE_MARGIN
note: bottom copper (tracks, vias, through-hole parts) stays inside the core, this far clear of the seam strip. Rev 3: both layers carry signals inside the core

name: MOUNT_SQ
note: 1/2 in HS-100 adhesive tie mount footprint (silkscreen square, mask only underneath): rev 3 has one per XIAO, on its pigtail, square to the cable

name: DECK_VARIANTS
note: duck spacings (DUCK_SPACING values) the generator builds, one deck per value: out/deck_d15, out/deck_d31 (owner 2026-11-23). DUCK_SPACING itself stays the old 146 mm deck's value

name: DECK_MIN_DIAMETER
note: smallest deck: face corners (r 69.3) + 2.7 mm, as the end plate. Deck diameter = max(this, 2 x (inradius + spacing + PAD_EXPOSE / 2 + DECK_EDGE_MARGIN)) (rev 3, 2026-11-23)

name: DECK_EDGE_MARGIN
note: board edge past the D hole's exposed pad

name: XIAO_CENTRE_V
note: rev 3: XIAO centre this far out along its core corner axis, USB-C end out (v 45), antenna end in (v 24); outer pad corners ~0 mm inside CORE_MARGIN

name: TIE_FROM_IPEX
note: tie square centre this far from the IPEX4 along the pigtail (corner frame u -16.34 v 17.86). 15 (owner 2026-11-23, was 13 in the rev 3 spec): the square sits 3.3 mm clear of the XIAO so it stays visible and reachable once the XIAO is on; 3.1 mm from the M3 washer keep-out, 1.4 mm from the nearest slot

name: PIGTAIL_ANGLE
note: pigtail direction leaving the IPEX4, in the corner frame (clockwise from straight out), toward the radio's own sector. 248 (2026-11-23, was 236): turns the tie square out of the centre clearance circle (inner edge r 17.4 -> 19.7); the square stays square to the IPEX4 -> tie line

name: M3_POS
note: rev 3 M3 registration holes: radius and first angle; the others at +120 and +240 (342 / 102 / 222), in the free ring between the radios

name: M3_KEEPOUT
note: washer keep-out round each M3 (no tracks or vias, both layers)

name: J1_POS
note: J1 (JST PH 4-pin vertical TH, 5V / GND / DATA / CMD like the carrier Up port) pin-row centre: radius, angle. 2026-11-23: on the head XIAO's axis just inside its antenna end, row parallel to that edge, housing on the bottom (inside the core) so only the pins are on top, outside DECK_CENTRE_CLEAR. Was r 17 at 76 deg

name: J2_POS
note: J2 (5V in, JST PH 2-pin vertical TH, housing on the bottom): pin-row centre radius, angle. 2026-11-23: on U4's axis just inside its antenna end, row parallel to that edge. Was r 17.5 at 322 deg

name: ENDPLATE_DIAMETER
note: end plate PCB across the far end of the triangle, FACE_H below the deck. Outer face corners at r 69.3: 144 leaves 2.7 mm of plate past them; under ~146 so it does not reach past the ducks. Not simulated (110 / 140 / 170 were) (2026-11-22)
